definitions.explanation: Pain in the stomach area. Can refer to both physical stomach pain and, figuratively, stress-induced discomfort.

examples.japanese: ストレスで{胃痛|いつう}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: I got a stomachache from stress.

examples.japanese: {胃痛|いつう}が{続|つづ}くようなら{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}ったほうがいい。
examples.english: If the stomach pain continues, you should go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal/medical than {胃|い}が{痛|いた}い (my stomach hurts). Also used figuratively in internet slang to describe emotional stress caused by watching something cringe-worthy or anxiety-inducing (e.g., {胃痛|いつう}アニメ — an anime that causes stomach-churning anxiety).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃痛|いつう}がする (to have a stomachache)
- {胃痛|いつう}{薬|やく}/{胃痛|いつう}の{薬|くすり} (stomach pain medicine)
- ストレス{性|せい}{胃痛|いつう} (stress-induced stomach pain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {腹痛|ふくつう}: abdominal pain — broader, includes intestinal pain
- {胃|い}が{痛|いた}い: my stomach hurts — casual/spoken equivalent
